regions.name: Screen-data stream: 20 records
regions.description: Screen-data command stream, $8045-$81B1. Records are [command][operands][next trigger lo][next trigger hi], run by the interpreter at $E5BD in bank 7 and dispatched through the ten-entry table at $E6F3. The trigger is a scroll position: $E6CE compares it against the running counter $B0/$B1 every step and fires the record when they match. THE EXTENT IS WALKED, NOT ARGUED: every byte here was consumed by a record whose length came from its own handler, following command 3 and command 9 jumps as a worklist rather than reading straight through - a linear read stops at the first command 3 with live bytes still ahead of it. 1 block start in this run; 20 records. Two checks carry it: the walk meets no byte that is not one of the ten commands, and the triggers never decrease within a block - which they would if any operand length were wrong. Generated by tools/parse-screen.py; the format is in tools/tgl/screen.py.
